title: LexicalSense
description: One documented Italian meaning or use of one LexicalItem for a Polish-speaking learner. The record contains lexical data only, not exercises or learning state.

lexical_sense_id.description: Stable identifier of this meaning, retained after editorial corrections.

lexical_item_id.description: Identifier of the one parent LexicalItem.

canonical_form_it.description: Snapshot of the parent item's canonical written form; must match the referenced LexicalItem.

part_of_speech.description: Grammatical role of the whole LexicalItem in this use; expression covers idioms or formulas without one useful word class.

definition_it.description: Short Italian paraphrase that distinguishes this meaning from other meanings of the same item.

definition_pl.description: Polish explanation of the same Italian meaning, not a union of unrelated translations.

glosses_pl.description: Short Polish equivalents that all belong to this one sense.

register.description: Choose unknown unless a source or supplied context supports a more specific classification.

patterns_it.description: Sense-specific argument structures, prepositions, or fixed components. Empty if no such pattern is known.

collocations_it.description: Illustrative typical combinations, never an exhaustive allowed-answer list.

constraints_pl.description: Semantic, pragmatic, regional, or syntactic limits that distinguish valid use.

evidence_id.description: Required for an attested example and must name an entry in evidence.

examples.description: Examples that demonstrate this meaning in a natural Italian context. Authored examples are illustrations, not source evidence.

locator.description: Entry URL, edition and headword, corpus citation, or stable input-record identifier.

supports.description: Only claims actually checked against this source.

evidence.description: Traceable support for the sense. Copying a source text is governed by its reuse terms.
